lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Harper Lane, twenty-four-year-old night-shift nurse and majority owner of Whitmore Shipping, grips her pregnant abdomen in pain outside the grand mansion.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Cole Whitmore, thirty-two-year-old billionaire CEO of Whitmore Shipping and her husband who hid his true identity as a mechanic, rushes to catch her.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: I cannot lose our baby, Cole, not after everything Diane and Jake put us through.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Cole carries his wounded wife past the shattered portraits of the disgraced board members who tried to murder his grandmother Evelyn.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: Seventeen-year-old Mia Lane runs down the grand staircase, her left arm finally free of the sling she wore since her heart surgery.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: Harper, your monitor on your phone is flashing red again.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Cole gently places Harper into the passenger seat of his sleek black Bentley.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: You promised to protect me and our child, Cole, no matter what enemies crawled out of the woodwork.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: I am taking you back to St. Brigid's Hospital right now where no hitman or relative will ever touch you again.

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - EMERGENCY ROOM - DAY

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID'S HOSPITAL - EMERGENCY ROOM - DAY

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Harper gasps for air as a team of trauma doctors rush her through the swinging double doors.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Cole grips the metal door handle as security guards block him from entering the high-risk trauma bay.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: Mia bursts into tears, leaning against her brother-in-law as the overhead hospital speakers blare a code blue.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: Evelyn left us fifty-one percent of the shipping empire to build a family, and I refuse to let death take you away from me too.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Harper's hand suddenly drops off the stretcher, her eyes rolling back as the heart monitor flatlines completely.
